name: Pop Art
description: Primary yellow, Ben-Day dots, and a comic-book outline.
bestFor: Campaigns and empty states that should hit like a printed comic.
promptFragment: Visual style: Pop Art. Use flat primary colors, a halftone dot field, thick black outlines, and a heavy condensed face. Shadows are hard offsets, not blur. Keep shapes graphic and flat. Avoid muted gray, thin type, gradients, and realistic depth. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
